limitations: Four structural policy classes are verified; real human-team behavior has not been empirically calibrated.
capabilities.user_problem: Changing names or weather is not enough; scenarios should require different coordination strategies.

limitations: The pack is an operational simulation pack, not a clinically validated treatment library.
capabilities.user_problem: People need to choose a training scenario and know that the same scenario can be recreated exactly.

limitations: Telemetry supports later calibration work; it does not itself establish real-world validity.
capabilities.user_problem: Reviewers need a trustworthy record of what happened during a simulation without storing patient-identifying data.

limitations: The offline exercise clock is deterministic but not calibrated to clinical operations.
capabilities.user_problem: Training may need to continue without a server or network connection.

limitations: Plain-language summaries explain the current evidence and limitations; they do not replace technical or scientific review.
capabilities.user_problem: People should not need to understand release engineering jargon to know what changed, what they can do, and what the system still cannot claim.

limitations: Passing software gates does not create clinical authority or empirical calibration.
capabilities.user_problem: Maintainers and reviewers need proof that the code, scenario artifacts, and reports came from the reviewed source.

limitations: A production network deployment must also enforce role authorization on the server.
capabilities.user_problem: Learners should not see answer keys, source points, or instructor-only information during assessment.

limitations: This is not a psychometrically validated proficiency measure.
Uncalibrated timing cannot change the score.
capabilities.user_problem: A single number hides what the learner actually did well or missed.

limitations: Discovered treatment concepts remain inactive until source, applicability, scope, effect, and independent review requirements are satisfied.
capabilities.user_problem: Users need to know why a treatment is available, blocked, or still awaiting review.
